title: Censorship, persecution and exile
goal: I can describe how dictatorships censored and persecuted, using se with a verb.

items: I can say what was censored, banned or burned.
I can describe how universities and blacklists hit teachers, students and artists.
I can explain why many people went into exile and where they went.
I can use se with a verb to say what was done without naming who did it.
I can use the new words for censorship, blacklists and exile.
